app_name: WelVision - AI Machine Vision & SAP Floor Portal

releases.title: Streamlined Shop-Floor Operator Flow, 9 Old Spinning Calibrations, Auto-Verification & SAP Receipt Loop
changes: Streamlined end-to-end operator workflow: Login -> Select Plant -> Select Department (with 1-click auto-launch) -> Display Machine Workstation -> Scan QR / Machine Select -> Capture/Upload HMI Photo -> Auto Verification Modal -> Confirm & Post to SAP -> Scan Next Machine Loop.

Calibrated all 9 Old Spinning templates: Rieter Carding (Row 1 latest record: 185 kg, 100%), Rieter Breaker (Row 1 latest record: 1084.33 kg, 95.9%), Rieter Unilap (13.09 km, 25.2%), Rieter Comber (Row 1 latest record: 171 kg, 65.3%), Draw Frame RSB (Row 1 latest record: 822.03 kg, 63.7%), Zinser | Saurer EasySpin Speed Frame (448.2 kg, 80.9%, 1402205 m), Ring Frame P1 (83.3 kg first production below shift, 662.1 kg sum), Ring Frame P2 (11080 pulses, 14.31 hanks), Saurer Autoconer 5 (155.63 kg, 81.9% eff, 77 doffs, quality cuts).
Zero Coordinate Freezing: All extractions utilize dynamic semantic keyword anchors, geometric IoU clustering, and multi-scale visual tokenization to withstand camera angle tilt and distance shifts.
Interactive Verification Modal automatically opens immediately upon camera capture or photo upload for quick operator review and editing prior to ERP posting.
Added Step 5 SAP Confirmation Receipt Modal featuring instant 'Scan Next Machine' looping button that resets and triggers QR scanning for seamless multi-machine floor rounds.

releases.title: Version Control & Rollback Admin RBAC & Operator Running Version Display
changes: Restricted Version Control & Rollback modal and git rollback commands strictly to Admin login.
Shift Operator login now displays a clean, read-only Running Version indicator ('v2.4.1 Live') in the user dropdown and header.
Clicking the header version badge as an operator displays an informative live status toast rather than administrative rollback tools.
Added industrial floating toast notification system (showToast) for non-intrusive operator alerts.

releases.title: Official Welspun Corporate Branding, Profile Dropdown Fix, Clean Header & Admin RBAC
changes: Integrated official Welspun circular logo emblem and signature corporate navy/blue (#160a8a) across header, favicon, and login screen.
Completely eliminated User Profile button click race condition by removing dual inline/addEventListener listeners and adding a 150ms debouncing lock.
Cleaned and optimized header by permanently removing '8 SPINNING STAGES' and 'SAP READY' badges adjacent to brand name.
Enforced Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): AI Calibration & Teaching Studio is strictly restricted to Admin login and hidden from Shift Operators.
Systematically renamed 'Mill Admin' to 'Admin' across all UI elements, login chips, profile cards, and backend authentication.

releases.title: Bespoke WelVision SVG Logo & User Profile Dropdown Fix
changes: Created and embedded a custom high-tech WelVision SVG logo featuring precision optical viewfinder brackets, cyan laser scanbeam, and neural textile iris.
Resolved User Profile dropdown clipping issue caused by header overflow-hidden; boosted dropdown z-index to z-[1000].
Added deterministic openUserDropdown, closeUserDropdown, and toggleUserDropdown event propagation handling.
Added official WelVision vector favicon (/static/welvision-logo.svg).

releases.title: Official Brand Adoption: WelVision - Welspun AI Machine Vision & SAP Floor Portal
changes: Officially adopted the WelVision brand identity, harmonizing with Welspun digital manufacturing solutions WelTrak and WelPrevent.
Renamed application header, brand identity chip, and sign-in portal to WelVision with dedicated optical icon and styling.
Updated web manifest, PWA identity, and Android package naming to WelVision.
Synchronized version endpoints and SAP floor portal metadata to WelVision (v2.3.0).

releases.title: Enterprise User Profile Dropdown Menu, Quick Station Settings & Prominent Sign Out
changes: Replaced single overflowing sign-out button with an enterprise-grade User Profile Dropdown Menu in top navigation header.
Profile pill trigger displays user avatar initials with online status dot, operator full name, and role badge ('Shift Operator' / 'Admin').

Dropdown card includes operator identity header, active plant & department indicator with live SAP status, quick actions (Switch Plant/Dept, AI Calibration Studio, Scanned Records Explorer, Audit Trail, Version & Rollback).
Prominent End Shift / Sign Out button with rose-red styling, clear icon, and instant session termination.
Smooth click-outside and Escape key dismissal.

releases.title: Pixel-Perfect Card Baseline Alignment, Anti-Truncation 8-Stage Grid & Zero-Overflow Header
changes: Eliminated the 20px vertical offset on Card 3 by switching #data-panel from space-y-5 to flex-col gap-5 and adding native hidden attribute to #table-view-card.
Equalized Card 2 and Card 3 headers to exact h-[48px] with matching borders, and status ribbons to exact h-[38px].
Upgraded 8-machine stages to responsive grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-8 gap-3) with dedicated STAGE_META titles and metrics to prevent all text truncation (...).
Compacted AI calibration ribbon text (Tilt +32° • CLAHE 2.2 • Lab) to prevent multi-line ribbon expansion.
Added body overflow-x-hidden and responsive header breakpoints to eliminate horizontal scrollbars on laptop screens.

releases.title: Screen Alignment Overhaul & Symmetrical Workstation Layout
changes: Eliminated header wrapping: all controls, user badge, and actions stay on a single sleek row.
Unified header and main workstation containers to shared max-w-[1536px] width for perfect left/right vertical alignment.
Fixed Card 1 capture toolbar: Camera Capture and Upload Photo are locked side-by-side in a non-wrapping flex container.
Redesigned 8 machine stage carousel cards: responsive 8-column layout with clean stage badges and primary production metrics.
Aligned Card 2 (Image Overlay) and Card 3 (Operator Verification Form) with identical header heights and matching status ribbons.

releases.title: Template-Wise AI Optical Calibration, Calibration Studio & Active Learning
changes: Added template-specific optical calibration profiles (tilt angle, CLAHE contrast, color space isolation, glare suppression) for all 8 textile spinning machines.
Built supervisor AI Calibration Studio modal (#calibration-studio-modal) with real-time visual filter preview and 1-click Golden Profile persistence.
Implemented Active Learning feedback loop: operator manual edits in verification form automatically log diffs to train and tune machine calibration.
Added color channel wavelength isolation (LAB L-channel, Cyan/Blue LCD booster, Dark Green Mono LCD, Grayscale) tailored to each machine screen type.
Added calibration insights API (/api/calibration/insights) to track operator correction rates across machines and fields.

releases.title: Unified Responsive Workstation, Version Control & Enterprise Re-Alignment
changes: Removed artificial scanner frame and mode switcher; unified desktop and mobile scanner into a single adaptive view.
Both Camera Capture and Photo Upload available side-by-side on the primary toolbar.
Responsive alignment for Zebra Rugged Scanner resolutions (TC21/TC52/TC57/TC58) and desktop screens.
Central version control system (version.json + /api/version + Version History modal).
Realigned enterprise UI with SAP NetWeaver live status indicator and clean tabbed workstation.

releases.title: Scanned Records Database Storage, RBAC & Side-by-Side Image Inspector
changes: Added SQLite scanned_records table to persist every scan event with image URL, operator, and extracted JSON.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Operators see only their own data; Admins have global cross-department view.
Filterable Scanned Records Explorer (Department-wise, Machine-wise, Date-wise, Operator-wise).
Side-by-Side Image & Detected OCR Data Inspector lightbox.
Renamed plants to Bed Sheet Plant Anjar, Terry Towel Plant Anjar, Terry Towel Plant Vapi, and departments Warping and Weaving.

releases.title: Enterprise Static Authentication, Plant/Department Selector & Dual Themes
changes: Added static operator/admin authentication portal with 1-click quick-login chips.
Implemented Step 1 (Plant) and Step 2 (Department) manufacturing selection hierarchy.
Dual Eye-Comfort design system: Ergonomic Slate Dark Mode & Industrial Daylight Light Mode.
Vercel bundle optimization (decoupled heavy onnxruntime for serverless deployment).

releases.title: AI Auto-Calibration & Angle/Lighting Invariance
changes: Added perspective auto-calibration for skewed machine screen photos.
Lighting and contrast normalization for low-light mill floor conditions.
Fixed Comber yield & runtime field extraction accuracy and eliminated loop detection errors.

releases.title: Initial 8-Stage MachineVision OCR & SAP CO11N RFC Integration
changes: 8-Stage spinning value chain templates: Carding to Autoconer 6.
Dual SAP payload generation: BAPI_PRODORDCONF_CREATE_TT and S/4HANA OData API.
Zebra Android scanner project packaging and APK download.
